_notes.source: Every value here comes from content already in the project: the homepage product cards, brand-guidelines.md (§5.2 image inventory, §15.5 product naming, §9.4 content colours) and the photographs themselves.
_notes.price: EVERY price is a PLACEHOLDER (priceIsPlaceholder: true): none has been supplied by the client. They are set in a plausible range for these sarees so the bag, Quick add, the price filter and price sorting can be used. Replace every one with the real price before launch.
_notes.description: descriptionStatus 'guideline' = text from brand-guidelines.md. 'draft' = a sentence assembled only from documented visual attributes (colour, border, motif). Approve or rewrite before launch.
_notes.nulls: null = not documented anywhere yet. The PDP hides any row or section whose data is null. Nothing is invented to fill gaps.
_notes.crops: Crops are zooms of the existing photos (s = scale, ox/oy = focal point, op = object-position). They stand in for dedicated drape and macro photography, which hasn't been shot yet.
_notes.secondShoot: Sarees 05–12 come from the second shoot (model photography folder). Their names are PROPOSALS in the same convention as the first four. Fabric is stated only where the photograph filename states it (silk, brocade); border and motif describe what is visible in the photographs. Prices are null: none have been supplied.
_notes.focus: images[].pos / images[].focus frame each photograph in the 3:4 gallery and card frame. The whole figure stays in frame; zoom is used only where the model is small in the photo.
_notes.styling: styling = one line listing only what is visible in the saree's own portrait (hair, jewellery, blouse). stylingStatus 'draft': approve or rewrite before launch. null hides the 'As styled' feature on the PDP. crops.styling frames that part of the portrait.
_notes.backdrop: backdrop = the photograph behind 'The Saree, Unfolded' on the PDP. img = which of the saree's own images; pos / posMobile = object-position on desktop / phone; wide = an optional landscape file of the same saree, used from tablet up.
_notes.closer: product.closer drives the "A closer look" section: a per-saree heading (draft copy) and up to three attribute pairs drawn from that saree's attributes. Without it the section falls back to the attributes directly.
_notes.trust: store.checkout and store.assurances appear under Add to bag on every product page. They are the wording requested for the site, NOT verified facts: confirm each payment method, the Silk Mark certification, the weave warranty and the shipping insurance before launch, and delete any line that isn't true. An assurance with a 'fabric' only shows on sarees recorded as that fabric.
_notes.shipping: store.shipping is PLACEHOLDER copy (store.shippingIsPlaceholder: true): the client has not supplied shipping terms. Dispatch time, delivery time, the "complimentary" claim and the insurance claim all need confirming, here, in the announcement bar (partials/header.html) and in store.assurances.
_notes.filters: store.filters.fabrics lists the fabrics the Fabric filter always offers, in this order, including ones with no sarees yet (shown as "Soon" and not selectable). A fabric a saree has that is not listed is added after them.
_notes.categories: categories: the client's shop categories, in their order. Regional ones show as tiles on the homepage; image stays null until their photograph is supplied. Assign a saree with product.categories = ["banaras-ki-bunkari", …].
_notes.productShots: images[].role: "detail" = the fabric close-up photo; "product" = the flat product shot, shown whole on its backdrop colour. Gallery order: portrait, print detail, border detail, product shot.
_notes.thirdShoot: Sarees 13–18 (Rangoli, Anaar, Saanjh, Sindoor, Kahani, Leela) come from the third shoot. Names and copy are proposals; fabric is unknown; categories are assigned from the visible style (ikat → Gujarat, bandhani → Rajasthan, Kalamkari → Pedana) and should be confirmed with the client.
_notes.support: store.support holds the contact details shown on /contact. All are null until the client supplies them; a null email or hours shows as a marked [Insert …] placeholder, and a null phone or WhatsApp is not shown at all. formEndpoint: the URL the contact form posts to (JSON). Until it is set, the form validates but tells the visitor their message was not sent. store.helpPagesDraft: true shows a 'Draft page' line on the five help pages; set it to false once their copy (render/info-content.mjs) is final.
_notes.catalogue: Sarees with source: "catalogue" come from "Stylish Nari Saree Catalog.xlsx" (91 rows) via _tools/add-catalogue.cjs. Description, price, range and fabric are the catalogue's; colours (coloursSource: "photo") are read from the photograph; names are working titles built from catalogue words (nameStatus: "catalogue"). attributes.silkMark records the catalogue's claim but is not shown. review[] lists what needs confirming for each saree; _tools/catalogue/review.md collects them.

store.shipping: Complimentary shipping across India. Orders are dispatched within 2–4 working days and usually arrive within 5–8 working days. Every parcel is insured in transit.
